front.title: Skill Intake Security Requirements for AI Agents (SKIS)

abstract.t: Skill Intake Security (SKIS) defines how an organization should examine a third-party skill, plugin or agent definition before it is allowed to act: four review levels graded by risk, a verification chain from provenance to a release record, and operational controls for updates, inventory, logging and revocation. AI agents increasingly extend their capabilities with third-party skills: packages of natural-language instructions, metadata and helper scripts that a model reads as authoritative context. Related work addresses agent identity, authorization, discovery and skill-layer risks; this document proposes a consolidated intake procedure with explicit organizational obligations. The verification chain covers provenance, integrity pinning, full-content inspection and comparison of declared versus observed capabilities. SKIS is vendor-neutral and intended to complement existing identity and provenance specifications.
